title: lonicera tatarica f. lutea
intro: Lonicera tatarica f. lutea, commonly known as the Golden Tatarian Honeysuckle, is a yellow-flowered variant of the Lonicera tatarica plant, which belongs to the Honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which may contribute to its use in treating various ailments including respiratory issues, wounds, and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera tatarica f. lutea include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which help in relieving cough and congestion, reducing inflammation, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
